title: Splat2Act: From Captured Scenes to Personalized VLA Manipulation
abstract: A user who brings a generalist manipulation policy into their home or office wants it to pick up their objects from their shelves, counters, and tables. Yet even a strong generalist like $π_{0.5}$ achieves 0% pickup success in our captured deployment scenes without adaptation, and collecting real demonstrations in every user's environment is prohibitively expensive. We present Splat2Act, an automated real-to-sim-to-real pipeline that personalizes a pretrained vision-language-action (VLA) policy to a specific scene and object set using only a handheld phone scan and images of the user's objects. Unlike prior real-to-sim work that reconstructs individual tabletops, Splat2Act operates on building-scale indoor environments: it builds a photorealistic digital twin with 3D Gaussian Splatting and collision geometry, automatically discovers tabletop and non-tabletop receptacles, constructs feasible pickup tasks, and generates successful demonstrations with a privileged simulation oracle, with only scene and object capture required from a human. Applied to 101 scanned campus environments with a median navigable area of 104.87 m$^2$ and 7 receptacles, the pipeline yields 852 receptacles and over 68,000 pickup demonstrations. We fine-tune $π_{0.5}$ in two stages: Stage 1 adapts to hundreds of public object assets, drawn either from the deployment scene alone or from all 101 scenes; Stage 2 personalizes to the user's own objects on the deployment scene's receptacles. Our strongest personalized policy reaches 62.5% aggregate pickup success in the target scene. Deployed on a real Stretch 3, the same policy achieves 63.9% success on a 12-task subset, closely tracking its 66.7% simulated success on those tasks. These results suggest that automated real-to-sim-to-real training can personalize VLA manipulation policies using only simulation-oracle data.
tldr: Splat2Act用手机扫描构建场景数字孪生，自动生成演示并两阶段微调VLA，实现个性化抓取。
motivation: 通用操作策略进入家庭或办公室后，希望从货架、柜台和桌面抓取用户物品；但强通用策略π0.5在捕获的部署场景中不做适配时抓取成功率为0%，而在每个用户环境采集真实演示成本过高。因此需要仅凭手机扫描和物品图像，将预训练VLA个性化到特定场景与物体集合。
method: 提出Splat2Act，一个自动化real-to-sim-to-real流水线：用3D Gaussian Splatting和碰撞几何构建建筑级真实感数字孪生，自动发现桌面与非桌面容器，构造可行抓取任务，并用特权仿真oracle生成成功演示，人类只需采集场景和物体。随后两阶段微调π0.5：阶段1在部署场景或全部101个场景的数百个公共物体资产上适配，阶段2在部署场景容器上针对用户自有物体个性化。
result: 在101个校园扫描环境（可导航面积中位数104.87 m²、7个容器）上，流水线生成852个容器和超过68,000条抓取演示；最强个性化策略在目标场景达到62.5%总体抓取成功率。部署到真实Stretch 3后，同一策略在12个任务子集上成功率为63.9%，接近其仿真66.7%。
conclusion: 结果表明，仅使用仿真oracle数据的自动化real-to-sim-to-real训练即可个性化VLA操作策略，无需在用户环境采集真实演示，为家庭和办公场景的机器人部署提供了可扩展路径。

title: Make It Flow: Animating Water in 3D Gaussian Splatting Scenes
abstract: Explicit 3D scene representations such as 3D Gaussian Splatting (3DGS) have recently enabled high-quality, real-time novel view synthesis. However, these methods assume static scenes, limiting realism in the presence of dynamic phenomena ubiquitous in real-world environments. While coherent motion (e.g., humans or vehicles) can be captured and reconstructed, high-frequency effects such as flowing water remain intractable under casual capture conditions, where dense multi-view, high-speed acquisition is not feasible. We present a method to animate water in static 3DGS scenes, enabling visually plausible motion without requiring dynamic capture or physical simulation. Our approach estimates 2D optical flow from reference images or model renderings and lifts it into a consistent 3D Eulerian motion field. We propose a cinemagraph-inspired algorithm that applies this motion field to deform Gaussian primitives, producing temporally seamless looping animations. The resulting representation retains real-time rendering performance, significantly enhances perceptual realism, and preserves free-viewpoint navigation within the scene. We evaluate our method on a newly captured dataset of in-the-wild waterfall scenes and demonstrate clear improvements over prior work in dynamic Gaussian splatting and 3D cinemagraph generation in visual quality and computational efficiency.
tldr: 将2D光流提升为一致的3D欧拉运动场来形变高斯基元，在静态3DGS场景中实现循环流动的水动画。
motivation: 现有3D Gaussian Splatting等显式3D表示假设场景静态，限制了真实感；而流水这类高频动态效果在随意拍摄条件下无法通过稠密多视角高速采集来重建或物理模拟。
method: 从参考图像或模型渲染结果中估计2D光流，并将其提升为一致的3D欧拉运动场；提出受cinemagraph（动态静图）启发的算法，用该运动场变形高斯基元，生成时间上无缝循环的动画。
result: 在新采集的野外瀑布场景数据集上评估，在视觉质量和计算效率上均明显优于先前的动态高斯泼溅与3D cinemagraph生成方法，同时保持实时渲染性能。
conclusion: 该方法无需动态采集或物理仿真即可为静态3DGS场景添加视觉上合理的水流动画，显著提升感知真实感，并保留自由视点导航能力。

title: SimVTA: Simulation-Grounded Video-Trajectory Alignment for Driving World Action Models
abstract: Driving world action models (WAMs) learn from paired trajectories and future observations. Post-training with reinforcement learning allows the policy to explore alternative trajectories and improve planning using driving rewards. However, driving logs contain future videos only for the recorded trajectories, leaving these alternatives without corresponding visual supervision. Thus, we introduce SimVTA, a simulation-grounded post-training framework that combines trajectory optimization with video supervision. First, we sample candidate trajectories for each observation and use a real-world simulator (e.g., World Engine) to render future videos for high-reward candidates in real-world scenes reconstructed with 3D Gaussian Splatting (3DGS). This provides trajectory-matched supervision independent of the model's own predictions. Under a limited rendering budget, we prioritize video supervision for higher-error futures among these rendered candidates. Finally, we optimize trajectory planning with Group Relative Policy Optimization (GRPO) and use a flow-matching loss on the matched videos to update shared representations. At inference time, the model predicts trajectories directly, without simulator calls. On NAVSIM v1, applying SimVTA to a WAM initialization improves PDMS from 86.2 to 91.3 (+5.1). It achieves 88.2 EPDMS on NAVSIM v2 and an average HD-Score of 38.8 in closed-loop evaluation on HUGSIM. Ablations show that updating shared representations with video supervision improves planning, while prioritizing higher-error futures among high-reward trajectories further improves performance.
tldr: SimVTA利用仿真渲染未来视频为高奖励轨迹提供视觉监督，结合GRPO与流匹配提升驾驶规划性能。
motivation: 驾驶日志仅记录已记录轨迹的未来视频，强化学习探索的替代轨迹缺乏对应视觉监督，导致世界动作模型后训练中的规划改进受限。
method: 对每个观测采样候选轨迹，用World Engine等真实感仿真器在3DGS重建场景中为高奖励候选渲染未来视频，并在有限渲染预算下优先监督高误差未来。采用GRPO优化轨迹规划，同时对匹配视频施加流匹配损失以更新共享表征；推理时直接预测轨迹，无需调用仿真器。
result: 在NAVSIM v1上，将SimVTA应用于WAM初始化使PDMS从86.2提升至91.3（+5.1）；在NAVSIM v2上达到88.2 EPDMS；在HUGSIM闭环评估中平均HD-Score为38.8。消融表明，用视频监督更新共享表征可改善规划，且在高奖励轨迹中优先高误差未来能进一步提升性能。
conclusion: SimVTA将仿真渲染的轨迹匹配视频监督与强化学习后训练相结合，为驾驶世界动作模型提供替代轨迹的视觉监督，显著提升规划性能且推理阶段无需仿真器调用。

title: Gaussian Splatting with Reflections Guided by What is Seen
abstract: While novel view synthesis methods like Neural Radiance Fields (NeRF) and 3D Gaussian Splatting (3DGS) have shown impressive performance on common scenes, they often struggle with capturing view-dependent specular effects, particularly near-field reflections. Existing methods utilize environment maps, which only represent lights from infinity, or environment Gaussians, which rely solely on indirect supervision from reflections, are insufficient for accurately modeling such effects. Here, we propose a framework based on 2D Gaussian Splatting (2DGS) that leverages directly observable environment information in input images. Our approach also integrates a hybrid reflection appearance representation and view-dependent specular modeling. Experiments on public benchmarks and a newly curated near-field reflection dataset demonstrate that our method achieves superior rendering quality and geometric accuracy.
tldr: 提出基于2DGS的反射建模框架，利用输入图像中直接可见环境信息与混合反射外观，提升近场镜面反射的新视角合成质量。
motivation: NeRF与3DGS等新视角合成方法在常见场景表现优异，但难以捕捉视角相关镜面反射，尤其是近场反射；现有环境贴图仅表示无穷远光源，环境高斯仅依赖反射间接监督，均不足以准确建模此类效果。
method: 提出基于2D Gaussian Splatting（2DGS）的框架，利用输入图像中可直接观测的环境信息，并集成混合反射外观表示与视角相关镜面建模。
result: 在公开基准和新建近场反射数据集上实验，表明该方法在渲染质量和几何精度上均取得更优表现。
conclusion: 该工作通过直接可见环境信息与混合反射表示提升了近场反射建模能力，为高保真视角合成提供了新思路。

title: PhysForge: Material-Controllable 3D Reconstruction with Separable Components
abstract: Recent advances in physical 3D generation have enabled visually faithful assets with simulatable mechanical behavior. However, existing methods provide limited control over material behavior beyond appearance-based inference and struggle to estimate physical properties from complex interactions between objects and semantic parts. Therefore, we present PhysForge, a Video Diffusion Model (VDM)-based framework for addressing these challenges, comprising two complementary modules for material-controllable physical fitting and componentlevel interaction modeling. The first, PhysFit, leverages material-conditioned VDM dynamics as references for physical-property fitting, introducing windowed fitting to focus on material-revealing interactions and Hallucinated Forcing to disentangle nonphysical motion hallucinated by the VDM from material responses. The second, PhysComp decomposes complex interactions into individual objects and semantic components, enabling their physical parameters to be optimized independently and flexibly composed for joint simulation. Experiments on PhysAssets and Google Scanned Objects demonstrate that, compared with existing methods, PhysForge provides stronger control over material-dependent physical responses while supporting component-level physical modeling for complex interactions. It achieves the best CLIP and physical controllability scores on both common and uncommon materials, with qualitative comparisons, component-level ablations, and a user study further supporting these improvements. Our project page is available at https://masterwanna.github.io/PhysForge.html .
tldr: PhysForge 提出基于视频扩散模型的可控材质物理重建框架，通过 PhysFit 与 PhysComp 实现材质可控拟合和部件级交互建模。
motivation: 现有物理 3D 生成方法虽能产生视觉逼真且可仿真的资产，但对材质行为的控制有限，往往只能依赖外观推断，并且难以从物体与语义部件间的复杂交互中估计物理属性。本文旨在解决材质可控物理拟合与部件级交互建模问题。
method: PhysForge 是基于视频扩散模型（VDM）的框架，包含 PhysFit 与 PhysComp 两个模块。PhysFit 以材质条件 VDM 动力学为参考进行物理属性拟合，引入窗口化拟合聚焦材质显著交互，并用 Hallucinated Forcing 分离 VDM 产生的非物理运动幻觉与真实材质响应；PhysComp 将复杂交互分解为单个物体和语义组件，使物理参数可独立优化并灵活组合以进行联合仿真。
result: 在 PhysAssets 和 Google Scanned Objects 数据集上，PhysForge 相比现有方法对材质相关物理响应具有更强控制力，并支持复杂交互的部件级物理建模。它在常见与不常见材质上均取得最佳 CLIP 和物理可控性分数，定性比较、部件级消融和用户研究进一步验证了这些改进。
conclusion: PhysForge 通过可分离组件实现材质可控的物理 3D 重建，提升了物理属性拟合与部件级交互仿真的可控性。该工作为生成可仿真、材质可调控的 3D 资产提供了新思路，并展示了在复杂材质与交互场景中的潜力。

title: Efficient Confidence-Aware Densification for 3DGS
abstract: 3DGS-MCMC has replaced the gradient-driven density control of 3D Gaussian Splatting with opacity-based sampling and relocation, and is now the de facto standard for prior-free densification under a fixed primitive budget. Because opacity stays high where the scene is already well reconstructed, this sampling sends most new primitives to the foreground and leaves the background under-reconstructed. At low budgets, prior-based methods such as ConeGS and EDGS outperform it, at the cost of a pre-trained radiance field or dense image matches and a separate initialization stage. We argue for a comeback of error-driven densification within the fixed-budget MCMC framework. Our confidence-aware densification keeps the fixed budget and gradual growth of 3DGS-MCMC, but places primitives by the image error instead of the opacity. New primitives are drawn mostly where screen-space gradients are large. We favor primitives with a low learned confidence, which marks regions the reconstruction still explains poorly, and relocate the primitives that contribute least to the rendered images to these places. Averaged over 24 scenes, our method outperforms 3DGS-MCMC in PSNR, SSIM and LPIPS at every budget from 100k to 2M primitives. At 100k, without a prior or an initialization stage, it recovers 0.84dB of the 1.05dB PSNR by which ConeGS leads 3DGS-MCMC, and from 500k on, it has the highest PSNR and SSIM of all fixed-budget methods we compare with, including ConeGS and EDGS. While inherently prior-free, our densification can also exploit priors: from the ConeGS or EDGS initialization, it matches ConeGS in PSNR and SSIM at 100k and is best in all three metrics at 500k.
tldr: 基于图像误差与学习置信度的置信感知致密化，在固定预算MCMC框架下超越3DGS-MCMC并媲美先验方法。
motivation: 3DGS-MCMC基于不透明度的采样使新图元集中在前景，导致背景重建不足；低预算下ConeGS、EDGS等基于先验的方法更优，但需预训练辐射场或稠密图像匹配及额外初始化阶段。
method: 在固定预算MCMC框架中回归误差驱动致密化：保留固定预算与渐进增长，但依据图像误差放置图元，主要在屏幕空间梯度较大处采样新图元；偏好学习置信度低的图元（即重建仍差的区域），并将对渲染贡献最小的图元重定位到这些位置。
result: 在24个场景上，100k至2M各预算下PSNR、SSIM和LPIPS均优于3DGS-MCMC；100k时无需先验与初始化即恢复ConeGS领先3DGS-MCMC的1.05dB PSNR中的0.84dB；500k起在所有固定预算方法（含ConeGS、EDGS）中PSNR与SSIM最高。以ConeGS或EDGS初始化时，100k匹配ConeGS的PSNR与SSIM，500k三项指标均最优。
conclusion: 表明误差驱动的置信感知致密化可在免先验条件下显著提升固定预算3DGS的重建质量，同时能兼容并利用先验初始化，为无先验与先验场景提供统一高效方案。

title: SplatQ: Interaction-Aware Pruning of 3D Gaussian Splatting via Quadratic Selection
abstract: Existing 3D Gaussian Splatting (3DGS) pruning methods primarily rely on global Top-K selection based on independent importance scores, lacking regional budget control and ignoring joint deletion effects. Consequently, they cannot ensure balanced reconstruction quality across a scene. We propose SplatQ, a combinatorial pruning algorithm that coordinates regional budget allocation and joint Gaussian selection under a fixed budget. SplatQ partitions Gaussians by spatial proximity and appearance similarity into size-limited blocks, decomposing global selection into subproblems of a specific size. It then smooths importance-based block retention quotas to prevent excessive budget concentration. Finally, it constructs a quadratic approximation of joint deletion effects using the responses of representative pixel colors to changes in Gaussian opacity. Individual responses, pairwise interactions, and quota penalties are incorporated into a quadratic unconstrained binary optimization (QUBO) objective, solved using simulated annealing (SA) or a coherent Ising machine (CIM) to jointly select Gaussians. Experiments on 5 benchmarks demonstrate that SplatQ outperforms state-of-the-art pruning methods in aggregate reconstruction quality, spatial quality balance, and rendering speed. Ablations confirm that budget smoothing improves local detail reconstruction, while interaction modeling improves Gaussian selection quality under a fixed budget.
tldr: SplatQ通过区域预算平滑与QUBO联合选择剪枝3DGS，提升重建质量平衡与渲染速度。
motivation: 现有3DGS剪枝多基于独立重要性分数的全局Top-K选择，缺乏区域预算控制且忽略高斯联合删除效应，导致场景重建质量不平衡。
method: SplatQ将高斯按空间邻近性和外观相似性划分为限大小块，将全局选择分解为固定规模子问题；平滑基于重要性的块保留配额，并用代表性像素颜色对不透明度变化的响应构造联合删除的二次近似；将个体响应、成对交互和配额惩罚纳入QUBO目标，用模拟退火或相干伊辛机求解以联合选择高斯。
result: 在5个基准上，SplatQ在总体重建质量、空间质量平衡和渲染速度上优于最先进剪枝方法；消融表明预算平滑改善局部细节重建，交互建模提升固定预算下高斯选择质量。
conclusion: SplatQ通过组合剪枝协调区域预算分配与联合高斯选择，为3DGS压缩提供交互感知的QUBO优化框架，并可利用SA/CIM求解，具有提升渲染效率与场景质量平衡的潜力。

title: NovaSplat: Model-Free 6D Object Pose Estimation via 3D Gaussian Splatting Onboarding and Refinement
abstract: 6D pose estimation of novel objects without CAD models remains an open challenge: model-free methods must build the object representation from scratch during onboarding and have long trailed their model-based counterparts. We present NovaSplat, a model-free pipeline that closes this gap. From a short smartphone video captured at onboarding, we train a 3D Gaussian Splatting (3DGS) model that serves both as a template source for detection and coarse pose estimation and as a differentiable backbone for pose refinement. Our refiner optimizes the object-to-camera pose with combined photometric and geometric losses under a continuous rotation parametrization free of gradient singularities. On a household-object benchmark, NovaSplat surpasses all model-based methods. On a challenging industrial benchmark with textureless and specular surfaces, it outperforms all model-free competitors while substantially narrowing the gap to model-based ones. We further introduce NovaSplat-Lite, an inference variant that is $3.1\times$ faster at negligible accuracy cost. Code will be made available at \href{https://github.com/POSE-Lab/novasplat}{https://github.com/POSE-Lab/novasplat}.
tldr: NovaSplat利用手机视频构建3DGS表示，实现无模型6D物体位姿估计与精化，并推出加速版Lite。
motivation: 无CAD模型的新物体6D位姿估计仍是开放难题：无模型方法需在onboarding阶段从头构建物体表示，性能长期落后于基于模型的方法。NovaSplat旨在缩小这一差距。
method: 从onboarding阶段拍摄的短智能手机视频训练3D Gaussian Splatting模型，既作为检测与粗位姿估计的模板来源，又作为可微骨干进行位姿精化。精化器在无梯度奇异点的连续旋转参数化下，结合光度损失与几何损失优化物体到相机位姿。
result: 在家居物体基准上超越所有基于模型的方法；在包含无纹理和镜面表面的工业基准上优于所有无模型竞争者，并显著缩小与基于模型方法的差距。NovaSplat-Lite推理变体速度提升3.1倍，精度损失可忽略。
conclusion: NovaSplat证明基于3DGS的onboarding与可微精化可让无模型6D位姿估计达到甚至超越基于模型方法，并提升工业等挑战场景的实用性；代码将开源。

title: CompactSplat: Spatially Adaptive Gaussian Distribution for Feedforward Scene Reconstruction
abstract: Reconstructing 3D scenes from sparse views without per-scene optimization remains highly challenging, especially for recovering accurate geometry and fine textures. While recent feedforward approaches leverage generalizable 3D Gaussian Splatting (3DGS) for scene generation, they typically assign one or multiple Gaussians to each pixel. Such uniform allocation not only produces highly redundant representations by wasting primitives in homogeneous areas, but also fails to exploit the inherent geometric priors of planar surfaces, often resulting in sub-optimal structural modeling. To address these limitations, we present CompactSplat, a novel feedforward framework that enables a content-aware allocation of 3D Gaussians. By integrating texture-guided spatial partitioning with hierarchical sampling, CompactSplat adaptively distributes primitives - concentrating dense Gaussians in complex regions while tiling flat areas with expanded, scale-modulated primitives. Moreover, our framework inherently supports dynamic sparsity control at inference time, enabling seamless trade-offs between rendering fidelity and memory footprint without requiring network retraining. Extensive experiments on RealEstate10K, DL3DV, and ScanNet demonstrate that CompactSplat consistently outperforms prior methods on both standard metrics and high-resolution rendering consistency, achieving high-fidelity reconstructions with significantly fewer primitives.
tldr: CompactSplat通过纹理引导空间划分与分层采样，实现前馈稀疏视角场景的自适应高斯分布重建。
motivation: 稀疏视角下无需逐场景优化的三维重建仍具挑战，尤其难以恢复准确几何与细节纹理。现有前馈3DGS方法通常为每个像素分配一个或多个高斯，导致均匀分配在平坦区域产生大量冗余，且未利用平面表面的几何先验，造成结构建模次优。
method: 提出CompactSplat前馈框架，融合纹理引导的空间划分与分层采样，实现内容感知的高斯分配：在复杂区域集中密集高斯，在平坦区域用扩展且尺度调制的基元平铺。该框架还天然支持推理时动态稀疏控制，无需重新训练即可在渲染保真度与内存占用之间灵活权衡。
result: 在RealEstate10K、DL3DV和ScanNet上，CompactSplat在标准指标和高分辨率渲染一致性上均持续优于先前方法，并以显著更少的高斯基元实现高保真重建；摘要未提供具体量化数值。
conclusion: CompactSplat通过内容感知的高斯分配缓解了前馈3DGS的冗余与结构建模不足问题，并支持推理时稀疏控制，为稀疏视角场景重建提供了高保真且资源高效的解决方案，有望推动可泛化3DGS在实际应用中的部署。

title: Measurable Semantic 3D Gaussian Splatting with Joint Region and Depth Supervision for Interactive Building Inspection
abstract: Image-based 3D reconstruction provides a scalable representation for building inspection and maintenance. However, photorealistic reconstruction alone does not fully provide the geometric measurability, semantic structure, and interactive information access required for engineering applications. This study proposes a measurable semantic 3D Gaussian Splatting (3DGS) framework with region and depth supervision for interactive building inspection from multi-view imagery. Mask-based region supervision suppresses irrelevant backgrounds and focuses optimization on target regions. Point-wise depth supervision guides Gaussian centers toward physical surfaces using reference geometry derived from multi-view stereo (MVS) point clouds, providing geometric anchors for measuring physical dimensions and areas. A semantic Gaussian field associates learnable class features with individual Gaussian primitives, enabling semantic rendering and component-level inspection. These capabilities are operationalized through AEC-SplatTwin, an interactive building inspection platform supporting real-time visualization, semantic analysis, quantitative measurement, and multimodal large language model (MLLM)-assisted interaction. On the synthetic UAV-inspection QuakeCity and smartphone-captured HKUPB datasets, the framework reduces Gaussian-center depth MAE by 58.1% and 86.8%, while its semantic field achieves mIoU values of 0.8529 and 0.8642. On HKUPB, the mean relative errors for height, width, and area measurements are 0.33%, 1.07%, and 0.60%. These results show that the proposed framework extends 3DGS beyond visual reconstruction into a measurable, semantically structured, and interactive engineering representation for building inspection.
tldr: 提出区域与深度监督的可测量语义3DGS框架及AEC-SplatTwin平台，用于交互式建筑巡检。
motivation: 仅靠照片级3D重建难以满足建筑巡检所需的几何可测量性、语义结构和交互式信息访问，需将3DGS扩展为面向工程的量测与语义表示。
method: 提出可测量语义3DGS：用掩码区域监督抑制背景并聚焦目标，用MVS点云生成点级深度监督将高斯中心锚定到物理表面；同时为每个高斯基元关联可学习类别特征形成语义高斯场，并构建AEC-SplatTwin交互平台支持实时可视化、语义分析、定量测量和MLLM辅助交互。
result: 在合成UAV巡检QuakeCity和智能手机采集HKUPB上，高斯中心深度MAE分别降低58.1%和86.8%，语义场mIoU达0.8529和0.8642；HKUPB的高度、宽度、面积平均相对误差分别为0.33%、1.07%、0.60%。
conclusion: 结果表明该框架将3DGS从视觉重建拓展为可测量、语义结构化、可交互的工程表示，提升建筑巡检的实用性与可量测性。

title: OuroWorld: Bringing Any 3D World Alive as Diverse, Endlessly Looping 3D Cinemagraphs
abstract: Recent 3D world models generate photorealistic, explorable scenes that remain frozen in time. OuroWorld is a mask-free framework that turns any static 3D Gaussian Splatting scene into a 3D cinemagraph: a dynamic scene with vivid, diverse motion looping seamlessly from any viewpoint. A vision-language model infers plausible dynamics and guides a video model to synthesize a reference video, which we lift and complete into multi-view videos. To learn from this imperfect supervision, we propose Inconsistency-Robust Periodic 4DGS: a Fourier-series deformation field guarantees looping by construction, while a Grounded Drift Field anchored at the reference view absorbs cross-view inconsistency. Unlike prior Eulerian methods limited to fluid-like motion, we capture general deformation, object motion, and illumination change. We introduce a ground-truth-free evaluation covering vividness, naturalness, loop seam coherence, and scene quality. On 39 reconstructed and generated scenes, OuroWorld outperforms all baselines and wins 70.8%-99.0% of user-study comparisons. Project page: https://ouroworld.userwei.com
tldr: OuroWorld 将任意静态3DGS场景转为可无缝循环、任意视角动态呈现的3D电影图。
motivation: 现有3D世界模型虽能生成逼真的可探索场景，但场景仍冻结在时间中，缺乏动态与循环能力。该工作旨在无掩码条件下，将静态3D高斯泼溅场景转化为具有生动、多样运动且可从任意视角无缝循环播放的3D电影图，并解决多视角视频合成中的不完美监督与跨视角不一致问题。
method: 提出无掩码框架：利用视觉语言模型推断合理动态，引导视频模型合成参考视频，再提升并补全为多视角视频。核心为Inconsistency-Robust Periodic 4DGS，其中Fourier级数变形场从构造上保证循环，Grounded Drift Field以参考视角为锚吸收跨视角不一致，从而支持一般变形、物体运动和光照变化，而非仅限流体运动。
result: 在39个重建与生成场景上，OuroWorld优于所有基线方法，并在用户研究中赢得70.8%-99.0%的成对比较。论文还提出无需真值的评估指标，覆盖生动性、自然性、循环接缝连贯性和场景质量。
conclusion: OuroWorld 使任意静态3DGS场景可变为多样且无限循环的3D电影图，为动态4D世界建模提供了对不完美监督鲁棒的新范式，并具备生成与重建场景上的广泛适用性。项目页面：https://ouroworld.userwei.com。

title: Slot3R: Set-Associative Spatial Memory for Streaming 3D Reconstruction
abstract: Streaming 3D reconstruction must preserve evidence from each frame while processing an expanding scene online. Spatial memory is a natural fit because it organizes history by reconstructed 3D location. Yet Point3R uses spatial proximity both to associate a new observation with an existing memory entry and to decide whether to fuse it, conflating co-location with state identity. Because pointers summarize image patches, nearby pointers may encode distinct surfaces, viewpoints, or visibility conditions; averaging them can destroy complementary evidence before later frames disambiguate it. We argue that location should determine address, not whether observations must merge. Slot3R realizes this principle as a training-free, set-associative retrofit that lets multiple states coexist at a shared address while keeping the pretrained Point3R backbone frozen. A bounded sparse readout further decouples persistent storage from per-frame decoder access. At 300-500 sampled frames, Slot3R reduces Point3R's point-cloud accuracy error (Acc) by 57.1%-63.1% on 7Scenes and 64.0%-72.0% on NeuralRGBD, lowers Sim(3)-aligned absolute trajectory error (ATE) on all three pose benchmarks, and remains competitive on video-depth estimation. It completes all evaluated settings from 600 to 1000 sampled frames at about 19 FPS under the same protocol, whereas Point3R and InfiniteVGGT run out of memory at 800 frames and beyond.
tldr: Slot3R 以集合关联空间记忆实现免训练流式3D重建，在精度和显存上均优于 Point3R。
motivation: 流式三维重建需在线处理扩展场景并保留每帧证据；Point3R 以空间邻近性同时完成观测关联与融合，混淆共址与状态同一性，可能将编码不同表面、视角或可见性的邻近指针平均，破坏互补证据。
method: 提出 Slot3R，一种免训练、集合关联式改造：位置只决定地址，允许多个状态共存于同一地址，同时冻结预训练 Point3R 主干；并用有界稀疏读出将持久存储与逐帧解码器访问解耦。
result: 在300-500采样帧下，Slot3R 将 Point3R 的点云精度误差 Acc 在 7Scenes 降低57.1%-63.1%、NeuralRGBD 降低64.0%-72.0%，并在三个位姿基准上降低 Sim(3) 对齐 ATE；视频深度估计保持竞争力。600-1000帧全部设置以约19 FPS完成，而 Point3R 与 InfiniteVGGT 在800帧及以上显存耗尽。
conclusion: 表明空间记忆应按位置寻址而非强制融合，Slot3R 在不重训练主干的前提下提升流式重建精度、位姿估计与长序列可扩展性，为流式3D重建提供高效空间记忆方案。

title: LVS: Local View Synthesis from Relative Camera Pose by Reusing Previous Views
abstract: Interactive scene exploration requires frequent view updates, although small camera motions preserve much of the visible content. Conventional 3D Gaussian Splatting nevertheless renders each target view, leaving this image overlap unexploited. Reusing rendered images offers an alternative. Geometric warping alone cannot recover newly exposed content and remains sensitive to depth errors. We propose a per-scene framework that replaces repeated scene rendering for nearby views with relative-pose-guided RGB-D image reuse. Geometric warping uses depth and relative pose to transport source content, while a lightweight multiscale network predicts RGB residuals to correct artifacts and infer missing appearance. Cached source features further reduce repeated computation. On GS-render, residual refinement improves PSNR by 0.72~dB over pure warping; evaluations on captured and rendered scenes demonstrate low query latency. This separation of scene rendering from local view updates supports responsive scene exploration, with potential applications in augmented and virtual reality.
tldr: LVS通过复用邻近视角RGB-D并校正残差，避免重复渲染，实现低延迟局部视角合成。
motivation: 交互式场景探索需要频繁更新视角，但小幅度相机运动下可见内容大量重叠；传统3D Gaussian Splatting对每个目标视角重复渲染，未利用该重叠。单纯几何warping无法恢复新暴露内容且对深度误差敏感。
method: 提出逐场景框架，用相对位姿引导的RGB-D图像复用替代邻近视角的重复场景渲染；通过深度与相对位姿做几何warping传输源内容，并用轻量多尺度网络预测RGB残差以修正伪影和推断缺失外观，同时缓存源特征减少重复计算。
result: 在GS-render上，残差细化较纯warping将PSNR提升0.72 dB；在真实拍摄与渲染场景上的评估表明查询延迟较低。
conclusion: 该方法将场景渲染与局部视角更新分离，支持响应式场景探索，并有望应用于增强现实和虚拟现实。

title: LIVIN: Benchmarking Spatial and Embodied Intelligence in Digital Twins of Lived-In Homes
abstract: Realistic household simulation must capture not only diverse environments but also the lived-in object arrangements and spatial constraints that shape robot motion and interaction. Existing resources often trade off scale, real-world correspondence, and interaction readiness, leaving a gap in faithful, interactive replicas of how real homes are actually arranged. To this end, we introduce LIVIN, a benchmark for spatial and embodied intelligence built on digital twins of 30 diverse lived-in homes. These replicas preserve observed room layouts, furniture configurations, and everyday belongings. To construct them, we design a human-in-the-loop workflow comprising instance recognition, architectural reconstruction, and object generation and placement, with intermediate results reviewed and corrected by humans against the source observations at each stage. We evaluate four tasks in LIVIN: 3D detection, 3D reconstruction, navigation, and loco-manipulation. Our evaluations show that current methods remain challenged by the dense object arrangements, occlusions, limited free space, and constrained interaction regions found in realistic lived-in homes. We hope LIVIN will help advance embodied AI in real-world homes, from spatial understanding to robotic interaction, and ultimately bring embodied intelligence into everyday home environments.
tldr: LIVIN 是基于30个真实有人居住住宅数字孪生的空间与具身智能基准，覆盖3D检测、重建、导航与移动操作。
motivation: 现有家庭仿真资源难以同时兼顾规模、真实世界对应性和交互可用性，缺少对真实住宅实际布置的高保真、可交互复现。LIVIN 旨在填补这一空白，支撑空间与具身智能研究。
method: 构建30个多样有人居住住宅的数字孪生，保留房间布局、家具配置与日常物品。采用人在回路流程：实例识别、建筑重建、物体生成与放置，并在各阶段由人工对照原始观测审核修正。基准评估3D检测、3D重建、导航和移动操作四项任务。
result: 摘要未提供具体量化指标；评估表明当前方法仍受真实住宅中密集物体排列、遮挡、有限自由空间和受限交互区域挑战。
conclusion: LIVIN 为真实家庭环境中的具身智能提供高保真交互基准，推动从空间理解到机器人交互的研究，并促进具身智能进入日常家庭环境。

title: Learning Which Correspondences to Trust: Confidence-Weighted Event-Camera Localization in LiDAR Maps
abstract: Localizing an event camera against a pre-built LiDAR map can be cast as dense optical-flow estimation between a rendered depth view and an event image, followed by a Perspective-n-Point (PnP) solver over the induced 3D-2D correspondences. Existing pipelines rely on geometric consensus during pose estimation, but do not explicitly model the reliability or pose informativeness, i.e., how strongly a correspondence constrains the camera pose, of individual correspondences. We show that the natural way to learn it -- using the per-correspondence error to constrain the learning of confidence -- suffers from a depth-dependent bias: small pixel errors reside predominantly at large depths and do not lead to high pose informativeness. Instead, in our method (CELL), we learn a per-correspondence confidence end-to-end through the pose, using a differentiable probabilistic PnP whose log-partition term encourages weight configurations that yield a better-constrained pose distribution. The learned confidence is used in three ways: (i) it reweights the flow supervision in a decoupled training scheme that keeps pose gradients out of the flow/edge backbone; (ii) it drives a probabilistic correspondence selection at test time; and (iii) together with the network's edge-probability it weights a final edge-matching refinement. We further design a partial-completion depth representation that adds signal without hallucinating across large gaps. On M3ED and DSEC our full system improves over the LEAR baseline on the majority of the evaluated sequences: it reduces the median translation error by up to 26.9% and the median rotation error by up to 15.8%.
tldr: CELL 用可微概率 PnP 端到端学习对应置信度，实现事件相机在 LiDAR 地图中的置信度加权定位。
motivation: 现有事件相机对 LiDAR 地图的定位流程把问题化为渲染深度图与事件图之间的稠密光流估计加 PnP，仅在位姿估计阶段依赖几何一致性，未显式建模每条对应的可靠性与位姿信息量（即该对应约束位姿的强弱）。作者指出用逐对应误差直接监督置信度会带来深度相关偏差：小像素误差多集中在大深度处，这类对应并不能提供强位姿约束。
method: 提出 CELL，借助可微概率 PnP 让置信度端到端经过位姿进行学习，其 log-partition 项倾向于产生使位姿分布更受约束的权重配置。学到的置信度有三种用法：(i) 在解耦训练中重加权光流监督，使位姿梯度不进入光流/边缘主干；(ii) 测试时驱动概率化对应筛选；(iii) 与网络边缘概率共同加权最终的边缘匹配精化。此外设计了部分补全深度表示，在大空洞处补充信号而不虚构深度。
result: 在 M3ED 与 DSEC 数据集上，完整系统在多数评估序列上优于 LEAR 基线，中位平移误差最多降低 26.9%，中位旋转误差最多降低 15.8%。
conclusion: 该工作表明显式学习“哪些对应值得信任”比单纯依赖几何一致性筛选更有效，为事件相机在 LiDAR 地图中的定位提供了置信度加权、位姿感知的方案，并可推广到其他基于对应的位姿估计流程。

title: Pose-Free Feed-Forward 3D Inpainting via Learnable Mask Attention and Support Token Refinement
abstract: 3D scene inpainting aims to recover missing or occluded regions in edited 3D scenes, while ensuring geometric and textural consistency. Existing approaches, however, typically require accurately calibrated camera poses, which restricts their applicability in casual, in-the-wild scenarios and introduces additional preprocessing overhead. To overcome this limitation, we present FreeInpaint, a novel feed-forward framework that generates complete and 3D-consistent scenes directly from unposed multi-view images with masked regions. At its core, FreeInpaint extends a 3D foundation model to propagate masked regions from a reference view to other unposed views, bridging 3D reconstruction and scene inpainting while preserving the model's native ability to recover camera poses and scene geometry. Our method addresses two key challenges in adapting feed-forward 3D foundation models to masked inputs. First, masked regions can corrupt cross-view correspondence reasoning, degrading pose estimation and geometry recovery. To address this, we introduce a Learnable Mask Attention mechanism that preserves the spatial anchoring of reliable observations while allowing masked regions to progressively absorb useful context in deeper layers. Second, under severe occlusions, a single forward pass often lacks sufficient appearance evidence for high-fidelity completion. Therefore, we propose a Support Token Refinement strategy, which injects diffusion-generated support evidence as confidence-weighted auxiliary tokens to refine under-observed regions while preserving the original spatial anchor. Extensive experiments across diverse datasets demonstrate that FreeInpaint achieves superior inpainting quality, eliminating the reliance on pre-computed camera poses while keeping a fast inference speed. The project page is https://rorisis.github.io/FreeInpaint/.
tldr: 提出FreeInpaint，无需相机位姿即可从多视角掩码图像前馈重建并补全3D场景。
motivation: 现有3D场景补全方法通常依赖精确标定的相机位姿，限制了其在随意拍摄的in-the-wild场景中的应用，并带来额外预处理开销。本文旨在直接从无位姿多视角掩码图像生成完整且3D一致的场景。
method: FreeInpaint扩展3D基础模型，将参考视图的掩码区域传播到其他无位姿视图，在保持模型原生的位姿与几何恢复能力的同时衔接3D重建与场景补全。针对掩码破坏跨视图对应推理的问题，提出Learnable Mask Attention，在保留可靠观测空间锚定的同时让掩码区域在深层逐步吸收有用上下文。针对严重遮挡下单次前向证据不足的问题，提出Support Token Refinement，将扩散生成的支持证据作为置信度加权辅助token注入，以细化欠观测区域并保持原始空间锚点。
result: 在多个数据集上的大量实验表明，FreeInpaint取得了更优的补全质量，消除了对预计算相机位姿的依赖，并保持快速推理速度；摘要未提供具体量化指标。
conclusion: FreeInpaint是一种无需相机位姿的前馈式3D场景补全框架，通过可学习掩码注意力和支持token细化，将3D重建与场景补全统一起来。它降低了in-the-wild多视角输入的预处理门槛，并可快速生成3D一致结果，有望推动3D场景编辑与补全的实用化。

title: PointVGGT: Zero-Shot Multiview RGB-D Point Cloud Registration with Visual Geometry Foundation Priors
abstract: This paper addresses multiview RGB-D point cloud registration, aiming to estimate global rigid poses for unordered RGB-D scans and align them in a metrically consistent coordinate frame. The conventional pairwise-then-global paradigm suffers from locally optimized pairwise registration, severe error propagation and high computational burden. In particular, existing methods typically treat RGB data as a mere auxiliary matching cue and overlook the holistic geometric priors (e.g., camera poses and 3D models) encoded across image sequences. This paper introduces PointVGGT, a zero-shot framework built upon a novel \emph{foundation-then-refinement} paradigm that systematically leverages visual geometry foundation models (e.g., VGGT) as the computational backbone for robust, training-free multiview RGB-D registration. In the foundation stage, we directly recover metrically consistent global poses (without any pairwise estimation) by grounding the scale-ambiguous pose predictions of the foundation model against metric depth observations. In the refinement stage, we introduce an efficient voxelized spatial hashing mechanism that exploits the globally coherent 3D reconstruction (induced by the foundation model) as a shared spatial anchor, enabling dense multiview correspondences in near-linear time. On top of this, an IRLS-based robust motion-only bundle adjustment is performed using a conjugate gradient solver to jointly minimize the correspondence and reprojection residuals for multiview pose refinement. Extensive experiments on indoor/object-centric/outdoor datasets verify the outstanding zero-shot registration accuracy and computational efficiency of our proposed method.
tldr: PointVGGT基于视觉几何基础模型先验，零样本实现多视图RGB-D点云配准。
motivation: 传统先成对再全局的配准范式易陷入局部最优、误差传播严重且计算开销高；现有方法多将RGB视为辅助匹配线索，忽视了图像序列中蕴含的相机位姿与3D模型等整体几何先验。本文旨在无需训练地实现无序RGB-D扫描的全局刚性位姿估计与度量一致对齐。
method: 提出foundation-then-refinement范式：基础阶段直接利用VGGT等视觉几何基础模型，通过度量深度观测校准尺度模糊的位姿预测，恢复全局度量一致位姿，避免成对估计；精化阶段采用体素化空间哈希，以全局一致的3D重建作为共享空间锚点，在近线性时间内建立密集多视图对应，并用IRLS鲁棒motion-only bundle adjustment与共轭梯度求解器联合最小化对应与重投影残差。
result: 摘要在室内、物体中心和室外数据集上进行了大量实验，验证了所提方法在零样本配准精度和计算效率上的优异表现；但摘要未提供具体量化指标。
conclusion: PointVGGT贡献了一种训练无关的多视图RGB-D配准框架，将视觉几何基础模型先验系统引入配准流程，避免传统成对估计带来的局部最优与误差传播，并可高效精化全局位姿；该方法有望推动零样本、可扩展的多视图RGB-D配准研究与应用。

title: CoCam4D: Geometry-Aware Cooperative 4D Perception for Camera-Only Autonomous Driving
abstract: Autonomous vehicles often suffer from limited perception due to occlusions, blind spots, limited sensor range, and the complex nature of surrounding environments. Multi-agent collaborative perception (CP) addresses these challenges by allowing vehicles to share sensory information and reconstruct the scene cooperatively. However, camera-only perception remains fundamentally limited by the uncertainty of distance-dependent monocular depth estimation. We propose CoCam4D, a Bayesian framework for collaborative perception that explicitly models geometric uncertainty. It uses a VGGT-based feedforward network to generate 3D Gaussian scene representations with associated uncertainty estimates, enabling multiple vehicles or agents to efficiently combine their observations. By sharing compact Gaussian primitives, reliable observations from one agent can reduce the depth uncertainty of another without requiring LiDAR sensors. To support real-world deployment, we introduce Dynamic Object Primitives (DOPs), a compact 35-byte representation designed for efficient C-V2X communication. Extensive experiments show that our proposed method consistently outperforms recent vision-only methods, achieving improvements of 11.48% on OPV2V+ and 10.62% on DAIR-V2X-C, demonstrating the potential of geometrically grounded collaborative perception for LiDAR-free autonomous driving.
tldr: CoCam4D提出贝叶斯协作感知框架，用带不确定性3D高斯表示实现纯视觉多车协同4D感知。
motivation: 自动驾驶单车感知受遮挡、盲区、传感器范围和环境复杂限制，多智能体协作感知可共享信息重建场景；但纯视觉方案受单目深度估计中距离相关不确定性的根本制约。
method: 基于VGGT前馈网络生成带不确定性估计的3D高斯场景表示，多个车辆或智能体通过共享紧凑高斯基元融合观测，使可靠观测降低其他智能体的深度不确定性而无需LiDAR；并提出35字节的动态对象基元DOP用于高效C-V2X通信。
result: 大量实验表明该方法持续优于近期纯视觉方法，在OPV2V+上提升11.48%，在DAIR-V2X-C上提升10.62%。
conclusion: CoCam4D验证了几何感知协作感知在无LiDAR自动驾驶中的潜力，并借助DOP支持实际部署，为纯视觉多智能体4D感知提供了新思路。

title: PAM-ToD: Plug-and-Play Appearance Modeling for Cross-Time-of-Day 3D Gaussian Splatting
abstract: Adapting a pre-trained 3D Gaussian Splatting (3DGS) road scene to a new time of day requires learning appearance changes from a few anchor images while preserving consistent, real-time rendering. We propose PAM-ToD, a lightweight plug-in that learns color corrections while keeping the pre-trained 3DGS parameters fixed. PAM-ToD scales each Gaussian's existing color to model illumination changes and uses an additive term for additional brightness, such as when street lamps turn on at night. Under a simplified image formation model, unchanged surface albedo can be eliminated from the relation between source and target appearances, allowing us to learn these corrections without separately estimating albedo and illumination. The model corrects colors across the scene while allowing the corrections to vary by location and by Gaussian. To guide learning from a few anchor images, it discourages abrupt spatial changes in these corrections. We also introduce CARLA-ToD, a benchmark with matching geometry, camera poses, and moving-object trajectories across three times of day. A few target-time anchor images are used to train each plug-in, while separate views are used for evaluation. Across the static and dynamic settings, PAM-ToD achieves higher PSNR and lower LPIPS than the baselines, even when the anchor images come from a single synchronized capture across multiple cameras.
tldr: 提出即插即用的PAM-ToD，在固定预训练3DGS参数下学习跨时段颜色校正，并发布CARLA-ToD基准，取得更高PSNR与更低LPIPS。
motivation: 将预训练3DGS道路场景适配到新时段，需要仅用少量锚点图像学习外观变化，同时保持几何一致与实时渲染。核心难点是在不重新估计反照率和光照、不微调3DGS参数的情况下实现跨时段颜色校正。
method: PAM-ToD是一个轻量插件，固定预训练3DGS参数，仅学习颜色校正：对每个高斯已有颜色进行缩放以建模光照变化，并加入加性项以建模夜间路灯等额外亮度。基于简化成像模型，源与目标外观关系中的不变表面反照率可被消去，从而无需显式估计反照率与光照；校正可按位置和高斯变化，并通过抑制空间突变从少量锚点图像中学习。作者还提出CARLA-ToD基准，在三个时段提供匹配的几何、相机位姿和运动物体轨迹。
result: 在静态与动态设置下，PAM-ToD相比基线取得更高PSNR和更低LPIPS；即使锚点图像来自多相机单次同步采集，仍保持优势。摘要未提供具体数值。
conclusion: PAM-ToD以即插即用方式实现了跨时段3DGS道路场景外观适配，无需单独估计反照率/光照且保留实时渲染能力；CARLA-ToD为跨时段外观建模提供了可控基准，有望推动自动驾驶仿真和数字孪生中的跨时段一致渲染研究。

title: OX-NeRF: 3D X-ray Tomography Reconstruction from Sparse Views Using Implicit Neural Representation
abstract: NeRF and Gaussian splatting methods have been successfully applied on X-ray scenes where the views are too sparse for 3D reconstruction via classical methods. Ultra-sparse scenes with 10 or fewer views such as those with high-rate or low-dose acquisition still, however, present a significant challenge. To address this problem we present a new framework, Optimised X-ray Neural Radiance Fields (OX-NeRF), that combines cross-scene feature learning with scene-specific optimisation to reconstruct sets of related scenes. OX-NeRF employs a convolutional neural network (CNN) to identify cross-scene features while maintaining scene-specific multi-resolution hash grids of spatial features. The paired representations are fused and passed to a multilayer perceptron (MLP); the CNN, hash grids and MLP are then jointly optimised end-to-end. Benchmarking on parallel-beam and cone-beam X-ray datasets shows OX-NeRF provides significantly higher reconstruction accuracy on ultra-sparse scenes compared to existing radiance field methods.
tldr: 提出OX-NeRF，融合跨场景特征学习与场景特定优化，实现10视图以下超稀疏X-ray CT高精度重建。
motivation: 经典X-ray CT重建在稀疏视角下失效，NeRF与Gaussian Splatting虽已用于X-ray场景，但在10视图以内的高速率或低剂量超稀疏采集下仍面临显著挑战。
method: OX-NeRF使用CNN提取跨场景共享特征，并为每个场景维护多分辨率哈希网格以表征场景特定空间特征；二者融合后输入MLP，并对CNN、哈希网格和MLP进行端到端联合优化，以重建一组相关场景。
result: 在平行束和锥束X-ray数据集上基准测试表明，OX-NeRF在超稀疏场景下的重建精度显著高于现有辐射场方法；摘要未提供具体量化指标。
conclusion: OX-NeRF通过结合跨场景特征学习与场景特定优化，为10视图以内超稀疏X-ray断层重建提供了有效框架，有望推动高速率或低剂量X-ray成像应用。

title: FlyMark: Training-Free Invisible Watermarking of 3D Gaussian Splatting via a Fruit Fly Connectome
abstract: A trained 3D Gaussian Splatting (3DGS) scene ships as a portable parameter array that can be copied, pruned, requantized, or repackaged outside its training pipeline, so ownership evidence is most useful when it lives in the released parameters and remains checkable long after the embedding tooling is gone. Existing 3DGS watermarks typically tie embedding or extraction to scene optimization, a learned decoder, or rendered views, so the evidence survives only as long as a second trained artifact does. FlyMark instead writes a keyed message into the parameters a 3DGS file already stores. Its carrier directions are derived from the photoreceptors of a published connectome, a citable versioned artifact that fixes the geometry exhaustively and leaves nothing to tune per scene. A virtual observer reads cone-wise apparent luminance along a scene-normalized orbit from stored centers, colors, and opacities; a keyed dithered quantization-index-modulation code replicates each message bit across these observations; and one sparse bounded least-squares solve realizes the targets through achromatic shifts of existing degree-zero colors under a hard per-channel linear-RGB bound. All geometry and higher-order appearance parameters are preserved bit-identically, and extraction needs only cone queries, rounding, and majority voting. Under a model-domain threat model on synthetic and real scenes, FlyMark attains high clean bit accuracy and visual fidelity while cleanly separating matched from wrong keys.
tldr: FlyMark 利用果蝇连接组载体，对 3DGS 参数做免训练隐形水印，提取仅需锥体查询与投票。
motivation: 3DGS 文件作为可移植参数数组易被复制、剪枝、重量化或重打包，现有 3DGS 水印依赖场景优化、学习解码器或渲染视图，验证证据存活依赖第二个训练产物。FlyMark 旨在将所有权证据直接写入已发布参数，并在嵌入工具长期不可用后仍可检查。
method: 从已发表果蝇连接组的光感受器导出载体方向，虚拟观察者沿场景归一化轨道从存储中心、颜色和不透明度读取锥体式表观亮度；用带密钥的抖动量化索引调制将消息位复制到这些观测，再通过一次稀疏有界最小二乘仅对已有零阶颜色做非彩色偏移实现目标，并受硬逐通道线性 RGB 界约束。几何与高阶外观参数逐位保持不变，提取只需锥体查询、取整和多数投票。
result: 在合成与真实场景的模型域威胁模型下，FlyMark 取得高干净比特准确率和视觉保真度，并能清晰区分匹配密钥与错误密钥；摘要未提供具体数值指标。
conclusion: 该工作提出免训练、参数内、可长期检查的 3DGS 隐形水印，利用可引用的连接组固定载体几何以避免逐场景调参，提取端无需学习解码器或渲染视图。其潜在影响是支持已发布 3DGS 资产的所有权验证与重打包场景下的来源追踪。

title: 3DTexMOR: 3D Gaussian Multi-Object Removal via Texture-Space Inpainting
abstract: 3D object removal aims to remove target objects from reconstructed scenes and complete the geometry and appearance of occluded regions. Existing NeRF- and 3DGS-based methods typically inpaint 2D images to guide 3D completion. However, complex multi-object layouts limit the surrounding context visible in each view, making 2D inpainting prone to artifacts. Inconsistent completions across views also introduce conflicting supervision and blurry reconstructions. We propose 3D Gaussian Multi-Object Removal via Texture-Space Inpainting (3DTexMOR). Our key idea is to perform inpainting in a unified texture space shared by all views. By combining complementary observations, this space provides richer context for recovering missing regions and promotes cross-view appearance consistency. We aggregate multi-view observations into texture maps, inpaint the missing regions, and reproject the completed maps into camera views to supervise Gaussian scene completion. To avoid the influence of view-dependent highlights and reflections, we decompose appearance and aggregate view-independent intrinsic attributes instead of RGB colors. We further introduce geometrically regularized Gaussian completion to constrain the geometry of the completed regions. Extensive experiments demonstrate visually plausible completions and state-of-the-art multi-object removal performance, improving PSNR by 5.8 dB and reducing LPIPS by at least 22% compared with existing methods.
tldr: 3DTexMOR 在统一纹理空间修复多视图缺失区域，并监督 3D 高斯场景补全，实现多物体移除。
motivation: 现有基于 NeRF 和 3DGS 的 3D 物体移除方法通常先对 2D 图像进行修复以引导 3D 补全，但复杂多物体布局使单视图可见上下文有限，导致 2D 修复易产生伪影。跨视图修复不一致还会引入冲突监督，造成重建模糊。
method: 提出 3DTexMOR，核心是在所有视图共享的统一纹理空间中执行修复，以聚合互补观测并增强跨视图外观一致性。具体将多视图观测聚合为纹理图，修复缺失区域，再将补全纹理图重投影到相机视图以监督高斯场景补全；同时分解外观并聚合视角无关的本征属性而非 RGB 颜色，以避免高光和反射影响，并引入几何正则化高斯补全约束补全区域几何。
result: 大量实验表明该方法能生成视觉上合理的补全结果，并在多物体移除任务上取得最先进性能：相比现有方法 PSNR 提升 5.8 dB，LPIPS 至少降低 22%。
conclusion: 该方法通过纹理空间跨视图一致修复与几何正则化，有效缓解 2D 修复伪影和跨视图冲突监督问题，提升了 3D 多物体移除的视觉质量与一致性，对 3D 场景编辑与重建补全具有潜在影响。

title: VGGTWorld-VLA: Intent-Conditioned 3D World Evolution for Autonomous Driving
abstract: VGGT provides a strong foundation for geometry-centric world models by recovering unified 3D scene geometry from visual observations. Although recent extensions enable temporal 3D prediction, their future evolution remains weakly conditioned on driving intentions and actions, limiting their ability to model alternative action-dependent futures. We propose VGGTWorld-VLA, an intention-conditioned extension of VGGT-World for controllable 3D world evolution in autonomous driving. First, we introduce an action--semantic conditioning mechanism that injects complementary driving semantics and ego-motion representations into the future-token stream, enabling different future geometry predictions for the same observed scene under alternative ego actions. Second, we develop a geometry--language--action bridge that adapts historical geometry, VLA semantic features, and maneuver and trajectory representations for joint conditioning of future geometry prediction. We evaluate future geometry prediction on NAVSIM, while conditioning ablations further examine the contributions of semantic and action information. Compared with the baseline, our method demonstrates competitive geometry prediction performance. Ablation studies further support the effectiveness of semantic and action conditioning. These results demonstrate the potential of semantic and action conditioning for controllable VGGT-based world prediction in autonomous driving.
tldr: 提出VGGTWorld-VLA，通过动作-语义条件实现自动驾驶可控3D世界演化。
motivation: 现有VGGT类世界模型虽能做时序3D预测，但未来演化对驾驶意图与动作的条件约束较弱，难以建模不同自车动作下的多种未来。
method: 作为VGGT-World的意图条件扩展，引入动作-语义条件机制，将驾驶语义与自车运动表示注入未来token流；并构建几何-语言-动作桥，联合历史几何、VLA语义特征及机动与轨迹表示来条件化未来几何预测。
result: 在NAVSIM上评估未来几何预测，较基线取得有竞争力的性能；消融实验进一步验证语义条件与动作条件的有效性，但摘要未提供具体量化指标。
conclusion: 结果表明语义与动作条件可推动基于VGGT的可控世界预测，为自动驾驶中意图驱动的3D世界演化提供新思路。

title: SatFix: Absolute Visual Localization of UAVs in Satellite Maps from a Single Oblique Image
abstract: We study absolute metric UAV localization within a provided geo-referenced satellite region, recovering continuous map position and viewing heading from a single oblique image or a short multi-view clip. Existing cross-view geo-localization methods retrieve the most similar satellite tile from a gallery and report Recall@K, but retrieval depends on gallery sampling, provides no heading estimate, and returns a tile index rather than a continuous coordinate. We propose SatFix, a feed-forward UAV--satellite localization framework built on VGGT-$Ω$. Satellite-grid features act as queries that aggregate UAV visual evidence, and two lightweight heads regress a 3-DoF pose in the satellite-map frame: continuous 2D position and heading. SatFix requires no explicit 3D map, rendered bird's-eye image, auxiliary sensor, or test-time pose alignment. A single model supports both single- and multi-view inputs, with trajectory constraints used during multi-view training. For metric evaluation, we introduce University-Metric, where satellite imagery is re-collected over a region up to 10.7$\times$ longer on a side (about 114$\times$ the ground area) than the original University-1652 tiles, with continuous position and heading labels for the original UAV tours. With one UAV view, SatFix localizes 52.08% of test frames within 50 m and 17.34% within 10 m, with median position and heading errors of 45.66 m and $20.81^\circ$, respectively. Inference takes under 0.1 s per single-view query on an NVIDIA RTX 4090. With nine UAV views, the median position error falls to 21.96 m and the median heading error to $8.73^\circ$. Compared with a fine-tuned VGGT-$Ω$ baseline, SatFix reduces median position error by 34.0% and nine-view median heading error from $25.43^\circ$ to $8.73^\circ$.
tldr: SatFix 仅用单张斜视无人机图像即可在卫星地图中回归连续 2D 位置与航向。
motivation: 现有跨视角地理定位方法多从卫星图库中检索最相似瓦片并以 Recall@K 评价，依赖图库采样，无法给出航向，且仅返回瓦片索引而非连续坐标。本文旨在实现卫星地图中的绝对米制 UAV 定位，从单张斜视图像或短多视角片段恢复连续位置与视角航向。
method: 提出 SatFix，一个基于 VGGT-Ω 的前馈 UAV—卫星定位框架：以卫星网格特征作为查询聚合无人机视觉证据，并用两个轻量头在卫星地图坐标系中回归 3-DoF 位姿（连续 2D 位置与航向）。方法无需显式 3D 地图、渲染鸟瞰图、辅助传感器或测试时位姿对齐；同一模型支持单/多视角输入，多视角训练时引入轨迹约束。为进行米制评估，还构建 University-Metric 基准，覆盖比原始 University-1652 瓦片边长长 10.7 倍（面积约 114 倍）的区域并提供连续位置与航向标签。
result: 单视角下，52.08% 测试帧定位误差在 50 m 内，17.34% 在 10 m 内，中位位置误差 45.66 m、航向误差 20.81°，在 NVIDIA RTX 4090 上单视角查询推理耗时低于 0.1 s。使用 9 个无人机视角时，中位位置误差降至 21.96 m、航向误差降至 8.73°；相比微调后的 VGGT-Ω 基线，中位位置误差降低 34.0%，九视角中位航向误差从 25.43° 降至 8.73°。
conclusion: SatFix 证明了无需检索图库或显式 3D 地图即可从斜视无人机图像直接回归卫星地图中的绝对米制位姿，并支持单/多视角与实时推理。其 University-Metric 基准和连续位姿评价推动了更贴近实际 UAV 定位任务的跨视角定位研究。

title: Rendering-Free Lookahead for Question-Guided Active Vision
abstract: Active robot vision requires controlling the camera to reveal task-relevant information that is hidden from the current viewpoint. For example, determining what is inside a box may require raising the camera and looking down into it. For viewpoint-dependent question answering, the challenge is to select camera motions that expose the visual evidence needed to answer the question. Although vision-language models (VLMs) can interpret observed images, selecting such motions requires anticipating the usefulness of unseen views. We quantify this usefulness as answerability, a VLM's estimate that a view suffices to answer the question, and present Rendering-Free Lookahead (RFL), a viewpoint-selection policy that ranks candidate camera motions by predicted future answerability. RFL transfers visual lookahead from deployment to offline training. At training, a privileged teacher renders candidate future views in 3D Gaussian Splatting (3DGS) scenes and uses a frozen VLM to compute one- and two-step answerability targets. Through two-stage distillation, a student learns to predict these action values from the question, recent visual observations, and a candidate camera motion. At deployment, RFL uses these predicted values to select camera motions without rendering future views. On 377 E3VS-Bench test episodes in unseen environments, RFL improves the mean judge score by 43\% over a direct-action baseline using the same VLM. These results support learning camera-control policies from privileged visual lookahead for viewpoint-dependent question answering.
tldr: 提出免渲染前瞻RFL，通过离线蒸馏预测候选视角可答性，实现问题引导的主动视觉相机控制。
motivation: 主动机器人视觉需要选择相机运动以揭示当前视角不可见且与问题相关的视觉证据；现有VLM虽能理解观测图像，却难以预判未见视角对回答问题的有用性。
method: RFL将视觉前瞻从部署时转移到离线训练：特权教师用3DGS渲染候选未来视角并由冻结VLM计算一步/两步可答性目标，再通过两阶段蒸馏训练学生模型从问题、近期观测和候选相机运动预测动作价值；部署时不渲染未来视角，仅用预测值选择相机运动。
result: 在未见环境的377个E3VS-Bench测试片段上，RFL使平均judge得分相比使用同一VLM的直接动作基线提升43%。
conclusion: 结果表明可从特权视觉前瞻中学习用于视角依赖问答的相机控制策略，且免渲染前瞻具有在主动视觉中部署的潜力。

title: Video-Conditioned Generative Joint 2D-3D Hand Motion Recovery
abstract: Recovering faithful 3D hand motion from video remains challenging due to frequent occlusions and incomplete visual observations, which make frame-wise pose estimates unreliable and temporally inconsistent. To address this problem, we propose JoHan, a unified generative framework that recovers hand motion directly from video sequences without relying on intermediate per-frame pose predictions. Trained from scratch, our model jointly generates aligned 2D and 3D local hand pose sequences by learning their temporal dynamics and cross-representation correspondence. The generated 2D trajectories exploit direct spatial and temporal cues from the 2D images to guide the following generative 3D motion reconstruction, while the learned motion prior promotes temporal consistency. Their learned 2D-3D correspondence further enables recovery of the hand's global position and orientation relative to the camera. Extensive experiments on challenging benchmarks demonstrate significantly improved accuracy and speed in local hand-pose and camera-space reconstruction. Notably, our method captures much better hand-motion dynamics, producing significantly smoother motion than previous methods while maintaining high per-frame pose accuracy.
tldr: 提出JoHan生成框架，从视频联合生成2D-3D手部运动，提升精度、速度与平滑性。
motivation: 视频中手部频繁遮挡和不完整观测导致逐帧姿态估计不可靠且时序不一致，因此难以恢复忠实的3D手部运动。
method: JoHan无需中间逐帧姿态预测，从头训练并联合生成对齐的2D与3D局部手部姿态序列，学习时序动态和跨表示对应；生成的2D轨迹利用图像时空线索引导3D运动重建，运动先验增强时序一致性，2D-3D对应进一步恢复相机坐标系下的全局位置与朝向。
result: 在挑战性基准上，局部手部姿态和相机空间重建的精度与速度显著提升；方法能更好捕捉手部运动动态，在保持高逐帧姿态精度的同时生成显著更平滑的运动。
conclusion: 该工作提供了从视频直接联合生成2D-3D手部运动的统一生成式方案，绕开不可靠的逐帧估计，提升了手部运动恢复的准确性与时序平滑性。

title: Gaussian Density Splatting Network
abstract: This paper proposes a novel crowd counting approach, the Gaussian Density Splatting Network (GDSNet). Unlike methods that rely on conventional, grid-based density maps and are sensitive to spatial resolution, GDSNet represents a crowd as a superposition of continuous 2D Gaussian primitives. Our approach is built upon two key contributions. First, we introduce a control-point-based fitting mechanism to structure the prediction of the Gaussian parameters. We design a method to allocate a set of control points that define local regions, from which features are pooled to regress each primitive's parameters. Second, we adapt a differentiable Gaussian Splatting framework to the counting task by parameterizing each primitive with geometric parameters and a scalar density mass. This formulation allows the network to be trained end-to-end via spatial matching of differentiably rendered density maps, naturally providing both local density supervision and global count optimization. Extensive evaluations on four standard benchmarks show GDSNet consistently outperforms the state of the art.
tldr: 提出GDSNet，用连续2D高斯图元叠加表示人群，并通过可微高斯泼溅与控制点拟合实现端到端计数。
motivation: 传统人群计数方法依赖网格化密度图，对空间分辨率敏感，难以连续、灵活地建模人群分布。
method: GDSNet将人群表示为连续2D高斯图元叠加；引入基于控制点的拟合机制，用控制点定义局部区域并池化特征以回归每个图元参数；同时将可微高斯泼溅适配到计数任务，每个图元由几何参数和标量密度质量参数化，通过可微渲染密度图的空间匹配进行端到端训练，兼具局部密度监督与全局计数优化。
result: 在四个标准基准上开展了广泛评估，GDSNet一致优于当前最先进方法；摘要未提供具体量化指标。
conclusion: GDSNet通过连续高斯图元与可微泼溅为人群计数提供了不依赖固定网格分辨率的端到端方案，其局部密度监督与全局计数优化结合有望提升复杂场景下的计数鲁棒性。

title: Argos: Adapt Rich Geometric Priors for Generalizable Online Scene-Change-Detection
abstract: Robots operating in dynamic environments require reliable detection of how their surroundings change over time. Existing learning-based methods largely rely on pairwise 2D image features, which struggle under large viewpoint changes and occlusions, are sensitive to noise, and show limited generalization across domains, while explicit 3D approaches typically require costly offline optimization. We show that the implicit 3D knowledge of Geometric Foundation Models (GFMs) provides a strong basis for addressing these limitations. We introduce Argos, which adapts GFM features for joint scene change detection and 3D reconstruction. To address data scarcity and take a step toward a foundation model for scene change detection, we introduce a large-scale benchmark comprising two synthetic datasets and one real-world dataset, and train jointly across diverse datasets to improve cross-domain generalization. We further introduce Argos-SLAM, a real-time system designed for robotics, which performs online change detection and change-aware 4D mapping. Across benchmarks, our framework substantially outperforms existing baselines, with gains of up to 42.01% in change IoU and 27.91% in F1, while supporting scalable deployment in changing real-world environments.
tldr: Argos 基于几何基础模型的隐式3D先验，实现在线场景变化检测与变化感知4D建图。
motivation: 动态环境中的机器人需要可靠检测环境随时间发生的变化。现有学习方法多依赖成对2D图像特征，在大视角变化和遮挡下性能下降、对噪声敏感且跨域泛化有限，而显式3D方法通常需要昂贵的离线优化。
method: Argos 将几何基础模型（GFM）特征适配到场景变化检测与3D重建联合任务中。为缓解数据稀缺并迈向场景变化检测基础模型，作者构建了包含两个合成数据集和一个真实数据集的大规模基准，并跨多样数据集联合训练以提升跨域泛化。进一步提出面向机器人的实时系统 Argos-SLAM，支持在线变化检测和变化感知4D建图。
result: 在多个基准上，该框架显著优于现有基线，变化IoU提升最高达42.01%，F1提升最高达27.91%，并支持在动态真实环境中的可扩展部署。
conclusion: 结果表明GFM的隐式3D知识可为通用在线场景变化检测提供强基础，贡献了大规模基准、联合训练策略和实时机器人系统，有望推动变化感知4D建图在真实动态环境中的落地。

title: DeltaSplat: Iterative Gaussian Refinement for Pose-Free Feed-Forward 3D Gaussian Splatting
abstract: Pose-free feed-forward 3D Gaussian Splatting (3DGS) reconstructs a scene from sparse, unposed images in a single network pass, removing the need for camera calibration and per-scene optimization. However, camera estimation errors propagate into the predicted Gaussians and compound the geometric and photometric inaccuracies of single-pass prediction. To correct these errors, we introduce DeltaSplat, a lightweight Gaussian refinement module for pose-free feed-forward 3DGS. It iteratively renders the current Gaussians at the input context views and predicts per-Gaussian updates from the resulting residuals. A 2D residual alone, however, underdetermines the 3D correction. DeltaSplat therefore conditions each update on per-pixel Plücker rays and rendered depth as a soft geometric prior. A dual-branch convolutional mixer efficiently encodes these inputs, and per-attribute heads decode the fused features into position, opacity, and color updates. The module adds only ~2.2% parameters to the backbone and remains fully feed-forward at inference. On DL3DV, DeltaSplat reaches 26.64 dB PSNR in the pose-free setting, improving its state-of-the-art backbone by 1.75 dB and surpassing even baselines supplied with ground-truth cameras; consistent gains hold across 6-24 views and all camera regimes.
tldr: DeltaSplat用迭代残差与Plücker射线/深度先验修正无位姿前馈3DGS的相机与几何光度误差。
motivation: 无位姿前馈3DGS可在单次网络前向中从稀疏未标定图像重建场景，但相机估计误差会传播到预测的Gaussian，并放大单次预测的几何与光度不准确问题。因此需要在保持前馈效率的前提下迭代修正这些误差。
method: DeltaSplat是一个轻量Gaussian细化模块：在输入上下文视角迭代渲染当前Gaussian，并根据渲染残差预测每个Gaussian的更新。由于2D残差无法唯一确定3D修正，它引入逐像素Plücker射线与渲染深度作为软几何先验，通过双分支卷积混合器编码，再由属性头解码位置、不透明度和颜色更新；仅增加约2.2%参数，推理仍完全前馈。
result: 在DL3DV的无位姿设置下，DeltaSplat达到26.64 dB PSNR，比其最优骨干提升1.75 dB，并超过使用真值相机的基线；在6-24视角和所有相机配置下均取得一致增益。
conclusion: 结果表明，迭代Gaussian细化能有效纠正无位姿前馈3DGS中的误差，在保持完全前馈推理的同时显著提升重建质量，并缩小甚至超越依赖真值相机的方法。

title: WAPR: A Foundation Model for Wide-Angle Refinement in Unseen Object Pose Estimation
abstract: Real-world applications require 6D pose estimation to be accurate, fast, and scalable to unseen objects. This paper introduces WAPR, a zero-shot wide-angle pose refinement model that refines candidate poses with rotational deviations up to 90 degrees. With as few as 12 candidate poses per detected object instance, WAPR supports fast inference within 1 s per frame and reaches a pose-estimation throughput of up to 25 detected object instances per second. To support wide-angle training for rotationally symmetric objects, WAPR uses rotational symmetry priors to canonicalize symmetry-equivalent pose targets before loss computation. We further construct SA6D, a large-scale 6D training dataset with such priors. SA6D obtains KASAL-assisted rotational symmetry priors for 944 GSO scans and expands them through geometry and texture augmentation into about 50K augmented object instances and about 2M rendered RGB-D images. In addition, an angle-balanced loss stabilizes learning across different angular ranges by reducing the influence of uninformative large-error cases. Experiments on seven BOP core datasets show that WAPR achieves state-of-the-art performance in unseen-object 6D pose localization and detection under both fast and unconstrained inference settings. Project page: https://github.com/WangYuLin-SEU/WAPR.
tldr: WAPR是面向未见物体的零样本宽角度6D位姿精化基础模型，支持90°旋转偏差且推理快速并达到SOTA。
motivation: 真实应用要求6D位姿估计兼具准确性、快速性和对未见物体的可扩展性，而大角度旋转偏差下的候选位姿精化仍是关键挑战。
method: WAPR是一种零样本宽角度位姿精化模型，可精化旋转偏差达90°的候选位姿，并仅需每个检测实例12个候选位姿即可快速推理。它利用旋转对称先验在损失计算前规范化对称等价位姿目标，并构建SA6D大规模6D训练数据集：通过KASAL辅助获得944个GSO扫描的对称先验，经几何与纹理增强扩展到约5万实例和约200万RGB-D图像。此外，角度平衡损失通过降低无信息大误差样本的影响来稳定不同角度范围的学习。
result: 在7个BOP核心数据集上，WAPR在快速与无约束推理设置下均取得未见物体6D位姿定位与检测的SOTA性能。其每帧推理时间低于1s，吞吐量最高达每秒25个检测物体实例，且每实例仅需12个候选位姿。
conclusion: WAPR为未见物体的宽角度6D位姿精化提供了可扩展的零样本基础模型，并通过SA6D数据集与角度平衡损失提升了对称物体和大角度偏差下的训练稳定性，有望推动真实场景中快速、鲁棒的6D位姿估计应用。

title: KASALv2: Fully Automatic 3D Rotational Symmetry Classification and Axis Localization
abstract: Rotational symmetry is an important prior in 6D pose estimation, improving pose accuracy and supporting symmetry-aware evaluation. However, current symmetry annotations for 3D objects remain largely manual or semi-automatic, often requiring predefined types or orders, which limits scalability. This work introduces a fully automatic, reference-free framework for symmetry-type classification, rotational-order identification, and full-axis localization across all eight canonical 3D rotational symmetry types. The method localizes a dominant high-order axis, infers its rotational order through self-consistency analysis, and reconstructs the complete symmetry structure under a hierarchy-guided formulation. A texture-aware extension further models appearance-induced reductions in rotational order while preserving axis orientations. Experiments on idealized and real-world datasets demonstrate strong accuracy and generalization, achieving 94.75% accuracy on 438 symmetric objects in GSO. Training FoundationPose with these priors improves accuracy by up to 0.9% across five BOP datasets, showing that automatically estimated rotational priors improve downstream 6D pose estimation. Code is available at https://github.com/WangYuLin-SEU/KASAL.
tldr: KASALv2实现全自动无参考的3D旋转对称分类与轴定位，并可提升6D位姿估计。
motivation: 旋转对称是6D位姿估计的重要先验，可提升位姿精度并支持对称感知评估，但现有3D物体对称标注依赖人工或半自动流程且常需预定义对称类型与阶数，难以规模化。
method: KASALv2是一个全自动、无参考框架，覆盖八类规范3D旋转对称：先定位主导高阶轴，再通过自一致性分析推断旋转阶数，并在层次引导下重建完整对称结构。其纹理感知扩展进一步建模外观导致的旋转阶数降低，同时保持轴方向不变。
result: 在理想与真实数据集上，方法展现出较强精度和泛化能力；在GSO的438个对称物体上达到94.75%准确率。使用其先验训练FoundationPose后，在五个BOP数据集上位姿精度最高提升0.9%。
conclusion: 该工作实现了可扩展的自动对称分类、阶数识别与轴定位，证明自动估计的旋转先验能有效改进下游6D位姿估计，并可为对称感知评估提供支持。代码已开源。

title: RLHND: Video Foundation Models as Physically Grounded Hand Trackers for Robot Learning
abstract: Recently, approaches that leverage human video datasets for robot policy training have become increasingly prevalent. However, most existing hand trackers regress pose from cropped frames with limited priors on hand motion and object interaction, resulting in inaccurate and physically inconsistent estimates. Moreover, the lack of physical cues, e.g., contact and force, limits the use of human videos for robot policy training. To this end, we propose RLHND, a video foundation model-based hand tracking model that jointly estimates hand pose and realistic tactile information from monocular egocentric videos. RLHND turns the pre-trained Cosmos 3 video diffusion backbone into a deterministic clip-level feature extractor via clean-latent conditioning, carrying its learned priors on hand motion and hand-object interaction into tracking. For pose estimation, RLHND (i) predicts hand poses with anatomically plausible joint angles and (ii) enables optional conditioning on the shape parameter to maintain consistent hand shape within the same video and even across videos recorded by the same actor. For tactile estimation, a separate tactile expert stream, trained with the pose stream frozen, predicts dense contact and force over the hand surface. We further adopt LBS-based feature spreading to enable vertex-wise feature extraction without costly per-vertex attention. RLHND achieves state-of-the-art performance across various benchmark datasets for pose estimation, while also achieving state-of-the-art performance in contact and force estimation. Moreover, we demonstrate the utility of RLHND for robot learning through retargeting results and real-world robot experiments. The code will be publicly available at https://seungjun-moon.github.io/rlhnd/.
tldr: RLHND将视频基础模型转为确定性特征提取器，联合估计手部姿态与触觉并用于机器人学习。
motivation: 现有手部跟踪器多从裁剪帧回归姿态，缺乏手部运动与物体交互先验，导致估计不准确且物理不一致；同时缺少接触和力等物理线索，限制了人类视频在机器人策略训练中的使用。
method: RLHND将预训练Cosmos 3视频扩散骨干通过clean-latent conditioning转为确定性clip级特征提取器，以继承手部运动与手物交互先验。姿态流预测解剖合理的关节角并支持可选形状参数条件以保持同一演员手形一致；独立触觉专家流在冻结姿态流下预测手表面密集接触与力，并采用LBS-based feature spreading实现顶点级特征提取。
result: RLHND在多个姿态估计基准上达到SOTA，在接触和力估计上也达到SOTA；通过重定向结果和真实机器人实验验证了其对机器人学习的实用性。
conclusion: RLHND表明视频基础模型可作为物理接地的单目自我中心手部跟踪器，同时输出姿态与触觉信息，从而拓展人类视频用于机器人策略训练。代码将公开于项目页面。

title: PPCAR-Net: Projection-Refined Parametric 3D Coronary Artery Reconstruction from Sparse X-ray Angiographic Views
abstract: Sparse-view 3D coronary reconstruction commonly relies on cross-view correspondence and triangulation, which are vulnerable to vessel overlap and foreshortening, or on volumetric prediction followed by vascular-graph extraction, which does not directly provide centrelines and radii. We introduce PPCAR-Net, a projection-refined parametric coronary artery reconstruction network that directly predicts a branch-structured centreline-and-radius representation without explicit point matching, triangulation, or an intermediate volume. Given a variable number of segmented views, a coarse predictor combines frozen VGGT features with learned branch queries to estimate branch presence, B-spline centreline trajectories, and dense radius profiles. Projection-guided geometry and radius refiners then sample local evidence from the input views and apply residual corrections learned with 3D supervision. We evaluate representation fidelity and sparse-view reconstruction quantitatively and qualitatively. On simulated angiographic masks generated from CT-derived coronary anatomy, PPCAR-Net produces better connected artery reconstructions and achieves strong centreline accuracy, particularly for RCA, while maintaining competitive volumetric overlap. Coarse-to-fine inference takes 121 ms, enabling real-time reconstruction.
tldr: 提出PPCAR-Net，从稀疏X射线血管造影视图直接预测分支结构的中心线和半径参数化表示，实现实时3D冠状动脉重建。
motivation: 现有稀疏视图3D冠状动脉重建方法或依赖易受血管重叠和透视缩短影响的跨视图对应与三角测量，或依赖体积预测后提取血管图，无法直接提供中心线和半径。
method: 提出PPCAR-Net，直接从可变数量的分割视图预测分支结构的中心线和半径表示，无需显式点匹配、三角测量或中间体积。粗预测器结合冻结VGGT特征与可学习分支查询估计分支存在性、B样条中心线轨迹和稠密半径剖面；投影引导的几何与半径细化器从输入视图采样局部证据，并利用3D监督学习残差修正。
result: 在CT衍生的冠状动脉解剖生成的模拟血管造影掩膜上，PPCAR-Net生成更连通的动脉重建，中心线精度高（尤其RCA），体积重叠具有竞争力；粗到细推理耗时121 ms，实现实时重建。
conclusion: PPCAR-Net通过参数化表示和投影细化，避免了显式匹配与中间体积，在稀疏视图下实现高精度实时冠状动脉重建，为临床介入提供了潜在应用。

title: TileSkipper: Region-Adaptive Tile Pruning for 3D Gaussian Splatting
abstract: Tiled 3D Gaussian Splatting rasterizers often use one scene-wide contribution cutoff for tile enumeration, although content differs in its sensitivity to support truncation. TileSkipper selects a static per-Gaussian cutoff policy for a frozen checkpoint. Calibration renders measure candidate pair savings and an isolated-removal distortion proxy that accounts for front transmittance and background color. The method allocates cutoffs across 64 Gaussian groups and accepts policies only after complete renders on disjoint selection views. The exported policy uses one byte per Gaussian, with no parameter updates, additional kernel, or per-frame policy inference. Across 13 scenes from Mip-NeRF 360, Tanks & Temples, and Deep Blending, a fixed-policy AccuTile sweep gives dataset-macro speedups of $1.088\times$ at standard resolution and $1.238\times$ at 3840 pixels wide, with $-0.007/-0.023$ dB mean PSNR change. Six integrations with existing opacity-aware bounds yield $1.009\times$--$1.121\times$ compiler-only speedups. For four ports from $3σ$ rasterizers, we separately attribute the prior exact-bound transition and our incremental gain. Matched-quality ablations show modest gains over scene-global calibration and parity with per-Gaussian control; the standalone comparison with AdaGScale is regime-dependent.
tldr: TileSkipper通过区域自适应瓦片修剪，在几乎不掉PSNR下实现最高1.238倍渲染加速。
motivation: 现有分块3D高斯泼溅光栅化器通常对整个场景使用统一的贡献度截断阈值来枚举瓦片，但不同区域内容对支撑截断的敏感度差异很大，统一阈值难以兼顾速度与质量。TileSkipper旨在为冻结检查点选择区域自适应的截断策略，减少冗余瓦片-高斯对。
method: TileSkipper为冻结检查点选择静态的逐高斯截断策略：通过校准渲染测量候选瓦片-高斯对节省量和考虑前向透射率与背景色的孤立移除失真代理，并在64个高斯组间分配截断阈值，仅在互斥选择视图上完整渲染后才接受策略。导出策略每个高斯仅占1字节，不更新参数、不增加额外核函数、也不进行逐帧策略推断。
result: 在Mip-NeRF 360、Tanks & Temples和Deep Blending的13个场景上，固定策略AccuTile扫描在标准分辨率下取得1.088倍数据集宏平均加速，3840像素宽下取得1.238倍加速，平均PSNR仅变化-0.007/-0.023 dB。与现有不透明度感知边界结合的6种集成取得1.009–1.121倍仅编译器加速；匹配质量消融显示相对场景全局校准有适度增益，与逐高斯控制相当，与AdaGScale的独立比较依配置而异。
conclusion: TileSkipper以极低存储与运行时开销实现区域自适应瓦片修剪，可兼容现有边界优化并显著加速高分辨率3D高斯泼溅渲染，同时保持近乎无损的画质，具备实际部署潜力。

title: Hardware-aware Calibrated Clustered Attention for Efficient Visual Geometric Transformers
abstract: The Visual Geometry Grounded Transformer (VGGT) marks a significant leap forward in 3D scene reconstruction, as it is the first model that directly infers all key 3D attributes (camera poses, depths, and dense geometry) jointly in one pass. However, this joint inference mechanism requires global attention layers with extremely long sequences that causes a significant latency bottleneck. In this paper, we propose blockwise clustered attention (BC attention) to accelerate the global attention layers in VGGT. By limiting the clustering within HW-friendly neighborhood blocks, BC attention reduces the computation overhead of query clustering as well as the costly data movement between on- and off-chip memory. This enables BC attention to scale to long sequences and deliver practical latency improvements on GPUs. Moreover, we introduce a hashing hyperplane calibration method and a threshold-based error compensation method to reduce clustering errors efficiently, which is a bottleneck in the current clustered attention mechanism. Overall, our experiments on GPU demonstrate that calibrated BC attention accelerates the global attention layers by 2.10-2.63$\times$ and the whole backbone by 1.77-2.35$\times$ with negligible loss (1%) for large scenes. With a small performance loss (< 5%), calibrated BC attention further achieves a 2.26-2.87$\times$ latency improvement on the global attention layers and a 1.90-2.55$\times$ improvement on the backbone.
tldr: 提出块状聚类注意力BC attention与校准补偿，加速VGGT全局注意力并显著降低延迟，精度损失小。
motivation: VGGT 能一次联合推断相机位姿、深度和密集几何等关键 3D 属性，但其联合推理依赖超长序列全局注意力，造成显著延迟瓶颈。现有聚类注意力存在查询聚类开销大、片上与片外数据移动成本高、聚类误差大等问题，难以在 GPU 上高效扩展至长序列。
method: 提出块状聚类注意力（BC attention），将聚类限制在硬件友好的邻域块内，从而降低查询聚类计算量以及片上/片外内存间的数据移动开销。同时引入哈希超平面校准与基于阈值的误差补偿方法，高效降低聚类误差。
result: 在 GPU 实验中，校准后的 BC attention 将全局注意力层加速 2.10–2.63×、整个 backbone 加速 1.77–2.35×，大场景精度损失仅约 1%。在小于 5% 性能损失下，全局注意力层和 backbone 分别进一步达到 2.26–2.87× 与 1.90–2.55× 的延迟改进。
conclusion: 校准 BC attention 在精度损失可忽略或较小的情况下显著加速 VGGT 的全局注意力层与整体骨干网络，使长序列视觉几何 Transformer 在 GPU 上更具实用效率，为高效 3D 场景重建部署提供了新方案。

title: PCAsplat: Gaussian Splatting with Local PCA Regularization
abstract: Gaussian splatting has emerged as a flexible representation for 3D reconstruction from posed images. However, existing methods are optimized primarily using rasterization-based losses, which supervise a splat only when it contributes to sampled camera rays. Gaussians that are occluded or contribute little to the sampled view therefore receive weak or no geometric gradients and may drift away from the underlying surface, producing undesired floaters. We introduce PCAsplat, a geometry-aware regularization framework for Gaussian splatting based on differentiable local principal component analysis (PCA). Our PCA regularizer acts directly on neighborhoods of Gaussian centers and can therefore update Gaussians that do not contribute to the current training view. We regularize the PCA eigenvalues to encourage Gaussians to move to the underlying surface with isotropic tangent-plane coverage. We also align each Gaussian normal with the PCA-estimated neighborhood normal to enforce consistent orientation. Experiments on DTU, Tanks and Temples, and NeRF Synthetic show that the splats produced by PCAsplat better approximate samples of the reference surface while substantially reducing undesired floaters. These surface-aligned splats enable downstream geometry-processing tasks, including point cloud segmentation, and direct Poisson reconstruction. Additionally, PCAsplat remains competitive under conventional novel view synthesis and mesh extraction tasks. Code will be released.
tldr: PCAsplat 用可微局部 PCA 正则化约束高斯贴合表面，显著减少漂浮物并支持下游几何任务。
motivation: 现有高斯泼溅主要依赖光栅化损失进行优化，仅对贡献于采样相机光线的高斯施加监督，导致被遮挡或对采样视角贡献很小的高斯缺乏几何梯度，容易漂离真实表面并产生漂浮物（floaters）。
method: 提出几何感知的正则化框架 PCAsplat，基于可微的局部主成分分析（PCA）：正则化器直接作用在高斯中心邻域上，因而可更新未参与当前训练视角的高斯；通过约束 PCA 特征值促使高斯移动到潜在表面并获得各向同性的切平面覆盖，同时将每个高斯的法线与 PCA 估计的邻域法线对齐以保证朝向一致。
result: 在 DTU、Tanks and Temples 与 NeRF Synthetic 上的实验表明，PCAsplat 生成的泼溅更接近参考表面的采样且显著减少漂浮物；在常规新视角合成与网格提取任务上仍保持有竞争力的表现。
conclusion: PCAsplat 通过局部 PCA 正则化获得表面对齐的高斯表示，可直接支持点云分割与直接泊松重建等下游几何处理任务，代码将开源。

title: LVSPM: Long Sequence View Synthesis and Pose Estimation Model
abstract: We present LVSPM, a generalizable model that jointly estimates camera poses and synthesizes novel views from uncalibrated image collections. Trained with only RGB images and pose supervision, LVSPM avoids dense 3D ground truth and employs test-time training (TTT) layers to scale seamlessly to hundreds of input views. On RealEstate10k, Co3Dv2, and DL3DV, LVSPM surpasses VGGT in pose estimation across 16-256 views, with especially large margins at strict thresholds. For novel view synthesis under a practical protocol where more views cover larger scenes, LVSPM achieves state-of-the-art pose-free quality---surpassing even pose-dependent models in PSNR---and still maintains high quality as scene scale grows, while baselines collapse. The code is available at https://burningdust21.github.io/Projects/LVSPM .
tldr: LVSPM联合估计相机位姿并合成新视角，借助测试时训练层扩展到数百视图，在多个数据集上超越VGGT并实现无位姿新视角合成最优。
motivation: 从无标定图像集合中同时恢复相机位姿并合成新视角，且避免依赖稠密3D真值，并需扩展到数百视图和更大场景。
method: 仅用RGB图像和位姿监督训练，不依赖稠密3D真值，引入test-time training (TTT)层，实现数百输入视图的可扩展联合位姿估计与视角合成。
result: 在RealEstate10k、Co3Dv2、DL3DV上，16-256视图位姿估计超越VGGT，严格阈值优势更大；在更多视图覆盖更大场景的实用协议下，无位姿新视角合成达到SOTA，PSNR甚至超过依赖位姿的模型，且随场景规模增大保持高质量，基线崩溃。
conclusion: LVSPM是一种可泛化的联合位姿估计与新视角合成模型，证明仅RGB与位姿监督加TTT可扩展到长序列和大场景，为无标定、无位姿依赖的3D视觉应用提供新方案。

title: Gaussian Density Splatting Network
abstract: This paper proposes a novel crowd counting approach, the Gaussian Density Splatting Network (GDSNet). Unlike methods that rely on conventional, grid-based density maps and are sensitive to spatial resolution, GDSNet represents a crowd as a superposition of continuous 2D Gaussian primitives. Our approach is built upon two key contributions. First, a control-point-based fitting mechanism is introduced to structure the prediction of Gaussian parameters. A set of control points is adaptively allocated to define local regions, from which features are pooled to regress each primitive's parameters. Second, we adapt a differentiable Gaussian Splatting framework to the counting task by parameterizing each primitive with geometric parameters and a scalar density mass. This formulation allows the network to be trained end-to-end via spatial matching of differentiably rendered density maps, naturally providing both local density supervision and global count optimization. Extensive evaluations on four standard benchmarks show GDSNet consistently outperforms the state of the art. The code is available at https://github.com/infinite0522/GDSNet-Gaussian-Density-Splatting-Network.
tldr: GDSNet用连续2D高斯基元叠加表示人群，通过可微高斯泼溅实现端到端且分辨率鲁棒的人群计数。
motivation: 传统基于网格密度图的人群计数方法对空间分辨率敏感，难以连续建模人群分布。本文旨在用连续2D高斯基元叠加表示人群，以克服网格化密度图的固有局限。
method: GDSNet引入基于控制点的拟合机制，自适应分配控制点划分局部区域并池化特征，以回归每个高斯基元的参数；同时适配可微高斯泼溅框架，将基元参数化为几何参数和标量密度质量，通过可微渲染密度图的空间匹配进行端到端训练，联合提供局部密度监督与全局计数优化。
result: 在四个标准基准上，GDSNet持续优于当前最先进方法；摘要未提供MAE、MSE等具体量化指标。
conclusion: GDSNet将高斯泼溅用于人群计数，以连续高斯基元和可微渲染替代传统网格密度图，形成分辨率鲁棒且端到端可训练的计数框架。代码已开源，有望推动连续密度建模与人群计数研究。

title: Post-Training Semantic Lifting for 3D Gaussian Splatting: Separating Detector, Lifting and Representation Error
abstract: The same Gaussian of a 3D Gaussian Splatting model is seen from many views, and these views do not always agree on the class it belongs to. The Gaussian may be occluded in some of them, and the confidence of the detector is not the same from one view to another. The ground truth, on the other hand, is given as an annotated mesh, because two training runs do not produce the same Gaussians. In this work, we propose a post-training lifting method that works with one target class at a time and combines the information coming from all the views. Target and non-target evidence are accumulated simultaneously, weighted by the visibility of each Gaussian in each view. After that, the Gaussians are filtered with two thresholds: a main threshold $β$ selects the high-confidence seeds, and a lower one $γβ$ adds the connected components around them. For the evaluation, the labels are transferred from the Gaussians to the mesh vertices that are both visible and annotated. With this design, we can separate three sources of error: the 2D detector, the lifting and the transfer between representations. The thresholds and the transfer operator are chosen on seven Replica validation scenes, and the method is evaluated on ten held-out ScanNet++ scenes with the same values for every scene and class. The mean mIoU on the validation scenes was 0.93 with masks from the dataset annotations and 0.65 with YOLO masks, and on the ScanNet++ test scenes it was 0.80 and 0.54. Compared with thresholding the evidence per view, as a previous version of the method did, the fraction improves the test mIoU by 0.24 and makes it possible to use a single threshold for all the classes and scenes of both datasets. Finally, the error analysis shows that most of the remaining error comes from the detector.
tldr: 提出后训练语义提升方法，融合多视角可见性加权证据与双阈值滤波，将3DGS语义标签迁移到网格并分离误差来源。
motivation: 3DGS中同一高斯在多视角下类别标注常不一致，且遮挡与检测器置信度变化使语义提升不可靠；同时因两次训练产生的高斯不同，真值需以带标注网格给出，因此需要一种后训练、跨视角聚合且便于分离误差的方法。
method: 对每个目标类，同时累积所有视角的目标与非目标证据，并按每个高斯在各视角中的可见性加权；随后用主阈值β选取高置信种子，再用较低阈值γβ加入其周围连通分量。评估时将高斯标签迁移到同时可见且被标注的网格顶点，从而分离2D检测器、语义提升和表示迁移三类误差。
result: 在7个Replica验证场景上选择阈值与迁移算子，并在10个held-out ScanNet++测试场景中使用同一组参数。Replica验证平均mIoU为0.93（数据集标注掩码）和0.65（YOLO掩码），ScanNet++测试为0.80和0.54；相比逐视角证据阈值化，测试mIoU提升0.24，并可跨数据集所有类别与场景使用单一阈值。
conclusion: 该方法有效提升了3DGS后训练语义提升的鲁棒性与跨场景泛化能力，并提供了分解检测器、提升和表示误差的评测框架；误差分析表明剩余误差主要来自2D检测器，提示未来应优先改进检测器质量。

title: VOMMI: Collecting and Leveraging Portable Demonstrations for Mobile Manipulation
abstract: Portable mobile-manipulation demonstrations can help alleviate data scarcity for embodied intelligence, but obtaining reliable, low-cost, and robot-free motion supervision from RGB observations remains challenging. Existing approaches often rely on teleoperation or specialized devices equipped with additional sensing hardware, while directly using estimated visual odometry (VO) trajectories can introduce inconsistencies due to accumulated drift and imperfect motion supervision. We present the Visual-Odometry-Conditioned Mobile Manipulation Interface (VOMMI), a portable demonstration collection and learning framework that connects portable RGB demonstrations to vision-language-action (VLA) post-training through offline trajectory reconstruction and online visual-motion conditioning.
